coach.quote: On Greystone, drill patience around Stoicism: open the trade while the deflect is still up so it eats the first basic attack, and save the Stone Forged Soul stasis for committed dives instead of using it as a panic button — the 2/5/1 loss was five solo-lane deaths against a 2-death norm.
coach.issue: backwards read of Stone Forged Soul
coach.rewrite: On Greystone, drill patience around Stoicism: open the trade while the deflect is still up so it eats the first basic attack, and cast Stone Forged Soul while the health bar is already low but before the killing blow lands — the stasis heal scales with missing health, so holding it back for a dive wastes most of it.

coach.quote: Willy wins more right after a loss (70%) than after a win (30%). Queue again immediately after losses; treat post-win games as the danger zone for autopilot.
coach.issue: small-sample streak sold as a rule
coach.rewrite: Over the last 21 games Willy won 7 of 10 after a loss and 3 of 10 after a win — a small sample, but it points one way: queue again straight after losses, and treat post-win games as the autopilot risk.

coach:player-16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-403.quote: Drill Kira's clock: the sustained-damage build spikes around minute 12 with Viper and finishes its third item by 24 — stack Vengeance with basic attacks before ever pressing the purge, and take Demiurge for +20.3% on the kit's main output at minute 15.

coach:player-a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-646.quote: Drill Kallari's exit, not just the entry: keep one dagger charge for the slow after the burst, and only cast the ultimate on already-wounded targets, where its missing-health damage finishes — the 8/6/2 and 10/6/3 games earned kills and gave all of them back.
coach:player-a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-646.rewrite: Drill Kallari's exit, not just the entry: keep one dagger charge for the slow after the burst, and save Shadow Dance for targets already carrying Death Mark, where it lands its bonus damage — the recent jungle games earned kills and then handed them all back.
